2.6 Mapping Software to different Core Partitions
To be able to map symbols of a BSW module (or any other software) to the correct memory the memory mapping mechanism according to AUTOSAR_SWS_MemMap shall be applied which offers an according multi-core support by introducing a core scope for the Software Addressing Methods. One can either apply GLOBAL (shared) or core LOCAL scope. Adding no scope, the mechanism assumes that GLOBAL scope is intended. The following little example considers the core scope only not taking care about the additional safety partition information. Therefore, it is assumed that all examples consider QM software only. To comply with the latest standard ‘QM’ is added to the SwAddrMethod accordingly.
